transcript.content: Hello. What brings you to the clinic today?
I'm really anxious because I feel like I'm constantly being watched and monitored by people who want to harm me. I've also been hearing voices talking to me when there'
I'm sorry you're going through that. Alongside these experiences, have you been feeling extremely down and depressed, or unusually energetic and high?
No, I haven't really experienced those extreme highs or lows. I'm mostly just feeling very anxious and stressed because of the people watching me and the voices I've been hearing.
Can you tell me a bit more about the voices you've been hearing? How often do they happen, and what do they say to you?
The voices have been happening on and off for about eight months now. They are usually just whispering or talking about what I'm doing, but it's hard to make out exactly what they are saying.
Have you noticed any changes in your motivation, or have you found yourself withdrawing from friends and family since these experiences started?
I haven't really noticed any changes in my motivation lately. I'm also not sure if I've been withdrawing from my family or friends, as I've mostly just been focused on dealing with the stress.
How have these experiences affected your ability to manage daily tasks, like working, studying, or taking care of yourself?

It has been really hard to focus on much of anything lately because I'm constantly distracted by these feelings. I find it difficult to get normal daily tasks done because I'm just so overwhelmed. I'm mostly just trying to get through each day right now.
Have you or those close to you noticed any changes in how you organize your thoughts, or has anyone mentioned that your speech has become difficult to follow?
No, I haven't noticed any changes in how I organize my thoughts. No one has ever mentioned to me that my speech is hard to follow or doesn't make sense.
